top: Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus...
bottom: hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight...

top: ...and had seen the grace of God, was glad,
bottom: ...that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

top: I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles,
bottom: ...for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

top: ...they received the word with all readiness
bottom: of mind, and searched the scriptures daily...

top: So mightily grew the word of God
bottom: and prevailed.

top: ...the ministry, which I have received
bottom: of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

top: ...we ceased, saying,
bottom: The will of the Lord be done.

top: ...arise, and be baptized, and wash away
bottom: thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

top: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer:
bottom: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

top: ...not knowing that the goodness of God
bottom: leadeth thee to repentance?

top: And if children, then heirs;
bottom: heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ...

top: Knowledge puffeth up,
bottom: but charity edifieth.

top: Now ye are the body of Christ,
bottom: and members in particular.

top: Who hath also sealed us, and given
bottom: the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

top: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ,
bottom: ...be ye reconciled to God.

top: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live;
bottom: yet not I, but Christ liveth in me...

top: For to me to live is Christ,
bottom: and to die is gain.

top: ...the riches of the glory of this mystery
bottom: ...which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

top: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly;
bottom: ...your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved...

top: But godliness with contentment
bottom: is great gain.

top: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul,
bottom: both sure and stedfast...

top: But now they desire a better country,
bottom: ...for he hath prepared for them a city.

top: But be ye doers of the word,
bottom: and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

top: But ye are a chosen generation,
bottom: a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people...

top: ...we have an advocate with the Father,
bottom: Jesus Christ the righteous:

top: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning
bottom: and the ending, saith the Lord...

top: ...a great multitude, which no man could number,
bottom: of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues...

top: ...Come out of her, my people,
bottom: that ye be not partakers of her sins...

top: ...saying, Alleluia:
bottom: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
